item.title: Local fire district hosts fundraiser for Safe Haven Baby Box
item.description: A local fire protection district is hosting a fundraiser this weekend aimed at bringing a Safe Haven Baby Box to North St. Louis County.

item.title: Flooding shuts down roads in Jefferson County
item.description: Area first responders are pleading with residents to avoid driving over flood-covered roads. The warning comes as water from the Big River shut down Highway BB from Cedar Hill to Hillsboro.

item.title: Fire breaks out in apartment building near Saint Louis University
item.description: St. Louis firefighters responded to a heavy fire at a seven-story residential building Friday afternoon on the 3800 block of Lindell. Crews arrived to find flames showing from the first floor of the structure.

item.title: Prosecutor: St. Louis rapper's shooting video lacks full context
item.description: A doorbell camera video showing a deadly shooting on a St. Louis doorstep has sparked debate online, but the city’s circuit attorney says the footage represents only a small part of the evidence investigators reviewed.

item.title: Fatal crash closes Shackelford Road in St. Louis County
item.description: A fatal crash has shut down a stretch of Shackelford Road in north St. Louis County as police investigate the incident.

item.title: Major Case Squad 'suspends' Carlyle death investigation
item.description: The Major Case Squad of Greater St. Louis announced Friday morning that they have suspended their investigation into a woman's death earlier this week.

item.title: St. Louis police budget and city services debate heats up
item.description: The intense debate over how much money the city of St. Louis will commit to its police department in the next fiscal year heated up even more Friday. City workers rallied in front of city hall over fear some of them may end up losing their jobs.

item.title: Six Flags St. Louis fans react to sale of theme park
item.description: Fans of Six Flags St. Louis are sharing mixed emotions after learning the longtime theme park will be sold to a new owner.

item.title: Widespread rain, some severe storms expected overnight Friday
item.description: Severe thunderstorms are expected to hit the St. Louis area late Friday night into early Saturday morning, with the potential for wind gusts up to 60 mph, dime to quarter-sized hail, and a quick, spin-up, short duration tornado.

item.title: Pam Hupp’s first planned court appearance in years takes a turn
item.description: After years of delays, the Pam Hupp murder case is finally nearing trial, with an expected start in August. Friday she was expected to make here first appearance in court in years, via video monitor.
